about.heading: Maximize Your Return, Minimize Your Stress
about.content: Selling your home is a major decision. At True North Property Group, we are dedicated to providing you with a seamless, transparent, and profitable selling experience. We combine market expertise with innovative marketing to showcase your property to the right buyers at the right time.

journey.sectionLabel: Your Path to a Successful Sale
journey.heading: The Home Selling Journey
journey.subheading: We guide you through every step of the process

phases.title: Phase 1: Walkthrough & Pricing
steps: In-home consultation to evaluate your property.
Discuss pricing strategies and timing for listing.

phases.title: Phase 2: Preparing Your Home
steps: Improve curb appeal and touch up paint.
Deep clean kitchens, bathrooms, and windows.
Have professional photos taken of your home.

phases.title: Phase 3: Marketing Your Home
steps: Publish listing on MLS in "Coming Soon" and then "Active" status.

phases.title: Phase 4: Showings & Offers
steps: Manage showings and collect buyer feedback.
Review, negotiate, and accept the strongest offer.
Ratify contract and move toward settlement.

phases.title: Phase 5: Under Contract & Closing
steps: Coordinate inspections, appraisal, HOA documents, and title company.
Manage contingencies and loan approval process.
Final buyer walkthrough, utilities transfer, and closing day.

benefits.title: Expert Pricing & Strategy

benefits.title: Professional Marketing Exposure

benefits.title: Skilled Negotiations
benefits.description: We advocate for your best interests, skillfully negotiating offers to achieve your financial goals.

benefits.title: Transaction Management from Start to Finish
benefits.description: Our team manages the entire closing process, ensuring all details are handled for a timely and smooth transaction.

costs.heading: Understanding Seller Costs
costs.description: We'll walk you through every dollar so there are no surprises at the closing table.

costItems.description: Current loan(s) and liens cleared at closing.
Optional credit to buyer (1–3%) to help with closing costs.
Transfer taxes, title company fees, deed prep, etc.
Disclosure/resale packages, prorated dues, capital contributions (if required).
Repairs, moving company, and any admin fees.
